name: Being Selfish
overview: Scripture warns against selfishness by calling believers to turn their hearts away from covetous desires and to avoid isolating themselves through self-centered pursuits. True discipleship is demonstrated by serving others as Christ did, who came not to be served but to serve and give His life for many. Believers are reminded that they cannot serve both God and worldly wealth, highlighting the incompatibility of selfish ambition with faithful service. The highest expression of love, laying down one's life for others, exemplifies the selflessness God desires in His followers.
